item.title: Wallet Drainer Hits Users Through Fake Airdrop Site
item.description: A fake airdrop site asked visitors to connect their wallets and sign a transaction, then drained their tokens.
item.content:encoded:
A fake airdrop site asked visitors to connect their wallets and sign a transaction, then drained their tokens.

The site copied the look of a real project and was promoted through hijacked social media accounts.

Never sign a transaction you don't understand, and revoke old token approvals you no longer use.
